answer: Exit burns half the bond; re-entry restarts maturation. Each identity posts an 80-credit bond tied to one cipher key, gaining full weight after three epochs. Leaving burns 40 for an umber receipt, and any return starts as a new island: no weight or history carries over, and a new 80 bond is due. Auditors check first; skipped maturation earns zero. Each rotation costs a fake 80 plus 40 burned: 1,000 fakes lock 80,000, and one rotation costs 120,000 more, 40,000 destroyed. Rented aged identities fail: transfer resets maturation, and the exit burned half its bond. Honest identities pay 80 once.
